correctness_confidence.basis: The table operands yield 2034.5488 ms without the intercept; adding 217.03 ms to the signed differences gives 1870.01154 ms. A vertex satisfying the box gradient conditions verifies the lower bound.

rigor.basis: The finite rounding endpoints have rational certificates. Selective reweighting follows by a finite exchange argument with a fractional final donor; uniform replacement uses the minimum cell. The manuscript avoids inferring actual implementation from a numerical match.

novelty.basis: The data-specific reconciliation and sharp nominal reweightings are original to this reanalysis. The methods are elementary convex optimization and finite probability.

significance.basis: An external user attempting to replicate the energy proxy selection faces a concrete discrepancy in its intermediate score. The paper gives a testable change of convention. It does not recover rankings for the remaining servers or establish bias in real energy use.

reproducibility.basis: Two exact computations use the published slopes and an independently parsed HTML table. Offline witness replay and two byte-identical PDF builds are recorded; original hardware traces remain unavailable for this check.

summary: I reviewed all three rendered pages and the exact PDF, including the rounding proof, intercept check, and the transfer witness. On the nominal design the apparent discrepancy exceeds all allowed rounding, while retaining the intercepts yields the published integer. I contributed the derivation and manuscript and assessed it in shared context.
strengths: Quantifies the gap left even after allowing all eight slopes to round independently.
Reproduces the reported integer using the two printed intercepts on exactly the same grid.
Provides a concrete probability-mass transfer achieving the counterfactual workload target.
weaknesses: One line containing the rational extrema on page 2 extends into the right margin but remains legible.
An explicit table of signs at the minimizing vertex would facilitate pencil verification.
The two alternative explanations are not distinguished using actual serving traces.
potential_errors: If the original evaluation grid used measured rather than nominal token counts, its distances could differ.
The corrected score of one configuration cannot be combined with scores computed using a different convention to rerank the servers.
A surrogate latency discrepancy cannot be converted into actual API energy error without additional measurements.
strong_novelty_candidates: For the same published model and 80 cells, the reported integer is excluded by every admissible zero-intercept rounding yet reproduced within 0.012 ms by the printed intercept difference.
